2026-10-24 20:52 83 runs firmware ntsc-gen 0.6.0 sample clock 14.318186 MHz levels 5.0 / 92.0 (sync/white code) colour colour_under

Observations of the TBC's output, with provisional grades above. "Ideal" describes what a perfect TBC of each class would output for that test. Input (CH2) is the generator's output, teed off before the TBC: it checks each run's input and gives the TBC's latency and its gain against the real input.

Grade (provisional)

Thresholds are first proposals (docs/design.md, Scoring), not yet checked against a known-good TBC. Judged against frame TBC ideals. Displacement is the excess over V0 (7.3 ns floor).
